thread:
maria_support: FYI customer ACME reporting streaming replies cutting off mid-response, client reconnects and receives only a partial chunk. They route: client -> Cloudflare -> ALB -> our envoy. No 5xx seen in their access logs, just stream closure.

devon_sre: Do we have their request/response traces or any proxy logs? Also what client (browser/curl) and whether HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1?

maria_support: Customer says browser EventSource; they attached a short capture: shows 200 OK then stream stops after ~14s, browser event-source `onerror` fires. They tried reconnect and got rest of message fragments. No explicit 502/504 from ALB.

ingrid_eng: Sounds like proxy or middlebox buffering / connection half-close. Common culprits: Cloudflare edge idle timeouts, ALB TCP idle/reset, or nginx/envoy buffering/squelch. Also Nagle/coalescing can delay trailing chunks if small.

maria_support: I asked for raw curl repro. They sent this snippet they used:```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  "https://api.acme.example/v1/stream?model=gpt-xyz"
```

maria_support: They also included partial server logs: `2026-03-10T12:34:56.789Z INFO stream write 120/1024 bytes; client closed connection` and envoy: `upstream reset: connection closed before end of response`

devon_sre: Ask them to try bypassing Cloudflare and ALB to confirm where truncation occurs. If bypass removes truncation then middlebox is culprit. Also ask them to run a tcpdump on the origin side or provide pcap from before/after. Example tcpdump command I usually give:```bash
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <client-ip> and port 443 -w /tmp/stream-trace.pcap
```

ingrid_eng: Repro checklist to send customer: 1) curl with HTTP/1.1: `curl -N --http1.1 -H "Accept: text/event-stream" <url>` 2) curl with `--no-buffer` and `-v` to show chunk timings. 3) Direct-to-origin URL (bypass CF/ALB). 4) If they can, capture a pcap and include timings.

maria_support: Sent those steps. Also suggested adding client header `Connection: keep-alive` and ensure any intermediate nginx has `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 300; proxy_send_timeout 300; tcp_nodelay on;` snippet I provided.

ingrid_eng: Additional notes for infra team: ALB default idle timeout is 60s but some setups or Path-based routing + health checks cause early resets. Cloudflare and Workers also have execution/idle timings (some edge plans ~30s). Nginx/Envoy can drop when buffers fill or when they see a half-close. Recommend enabling periodic heartbeat SSE comment from our runtime (e.g., `:keepalive\n\n` every 10s) to keep intermediaries from tearing down.

devon_sre: If customer can reproduce quickly, capture `ss -tin` and `netstat -anp` around the event to see FIN/RST flags. Also get envoy admin /stats for `listener.0.downstream_cx_xxx` counters. Example tcpdump filter I ask for:```bash
sudo tcpdump -s 0 -w sse.pcap host <client-ip> and port 443 and '(tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-fin|tcp-rst) != 0)'
```

maria_support: Customer tried direct-to-origin bypassing ALB/Cloudflare and says stream stays open and full response completes. They've scheduled an ALB-side test later today.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for runtime v3.4.1 completed to us-west-2. No changes to streaming keepalive config. :white_check_mark:

ingrid_eng: Given direct-origin success, ALB (or Cloudflare between client and ALB) is likely. Short-term workaround: enable server-side heartbeats in our runtime (will push a patch to enable by default for streaming routes) and suggest customer increase ALB idle timeout to >=120s. For nginx fronting ALB, `sendfile off; tcp_nodelay on; proxy_buffering off;` tends to help for small-chunk SSE.

maria_support: Sent config snippet and asked them to increase ALB idle timeout and disable CF 'Always Online' and any worker-level response aggregation. Also asked for pcap capture when they run the ALB test.

devon_sre: If ALB test still repros, we should engage infra to look at ELB logs and NLB/ALB connection resets. Capture of ELB connection IDs + client ip + timestamps will let AWS support correlate internal resets.

maria_support: Customer confirms ALB test shows truncation; will send ELB access logs + pcap. I've escalated to infra with links to the thread and requested AWS support case if needed.

ingrid_eng: Plan: 1) ship runtime heartbeat toggle as hotfix; 2) recommend customer ALB/CF config changes; 3) if still failing, gather ELB internal traces with AWS. Thanks team.

maria_support: Keeping this open until AWS/ELB confirms root cause. Will post updates when we have ELB logs. :eyes:
